items.title: Ray Drummond interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003
items.q: Mor Thiam, the Senegalese drummer who also was in Don Pullen’s “African- Brazilian” connection.

ctx.x: Can you tell me, is there a spiritual side to your music? A spiritual element?

I hope so. I hope so. Especially I think it’s most evident in “The Excursion.” I don’t know if you’re familiar with that recording at all but “The Excurision” has Lovano and Craig Handy and Mor Thiam, the Senegalese drummer who also was in Don Pullen’s “African- Brazilian” connection. Danillo Perez, Marvin “Smitty” Smith. That recording is the most spiritual of all the recordings that I’ve had. And there is a definitely a spiritual connection, in fact that is the direction that I’d like to actually get deeper…
Would that be on your short list of things you’ve played on that you feel the best about?
